name: TradingView invite-only indicator suite
one_line: 2-3 polished Pine Script indicators (regime/vol dashboards) sold as invite-only subscription access to US/EU retail traders on non-India markets (ES/NQ/BTC/US stocks), $20-40/mo, marketed via faceless X/Shorts channel and free public scripts.

name: AI-native trading journal / options-analytics SaaS
one_line: AI-first trade journal (contract-note/CSV ingest, LLM-written weekly 'why you lost money' reviews) undercutting TraderSync/TradeZella for global retail traders at $10-29/mo, with India F&O localization at Rs199-399/mo; strictly retrospective, no signals.

name: Python/AI backtesting skills course
one_line: Non-advice quant skills transfer — 'backtest any strategy with Python + AI' self-serve course/repo at $79-199 on Gumroad/Whop for global buyers, with an India-facing pre-sold Rs2,999-4,999 'Python + AI for data analysis' webinar-funnel variant; historical data only, no named securities.

name: Quant-methods engineering newsletter
one_line: Anonymous $8-10/mo 'how to build/test strategies' engineering newsletter (Substack), for global quant-curious traders — positioned as marketing/funnel for P01-P03 rather than a standalone business.

name: Niche ASO mobile utility (HabitKit pattern)
one_line: Single-purpose local-first tracker/utility (habit grid, medication, plant care, exam countdown — literal Reddit asks) for US/UK consumers at $2-4/mo or $20-40 lifetime, hard paywall, pure ASO distribution, zero backend; run 2-3 in parallel.

name: Single-purpose consumer AI photo app (Cal-AI pattern)
one_line: Photo-in/wow-out AI app in an underserved vertical (South Asian matrimonial/wedding portraits, medical-professional headshots, or another photo-to-answer job) sold to US/diaspora at $4.99/wk or $10-15 credit packs, grown via paid micro-UGC creators, iOS-first hard paywall.

name: Chrome extension / web micro-tool via MoR
one_line: Paid browser extension or web tool solving one repeated prosumer annoyance, $5-10/mo through Paddle/Polar merchant-of-record for US/EU buyers; lowest cost (~Rs2K), slowest ramp, potential 24-36x MRR exit.

name: Brother-fronted NEET-PG/FMGE AI study system
one_line: MBBS-brother-fronted exam ecosystem for Indian medical PG aspirants — original Anki-deck sets + AI viva/vignette tutor + rapid-revision notes, Rs999-2,999 founding product plus Rs199-499/mo community, undercutting Marrow's Rs28K+/yr; exam rank-predictor viral cards as the WhatsApp funnel.

name: AI Vedic astrology chat & reports
one_line: Faceless AI kundli chat + flat-price detailed PDF reports (marriage timing, dasha, varshphal) for India at Rs99-299 one-shot and Vedic-packaged subscriptions for diaspora/Western buyers at $9.99-19.99/mo, flanking Astrotalk's per-minute meter and Nebula's US pricing; WhatsApp-forwardable match/forecast cards as the viral loop.

name: India-localized food calorie-scan app
one_line: Indian-cuisine-accurate photo calorie scanner (thalis, dal/sabzi portions where US apps fail) at Rs99-199/mo via desi-fitness nano-influencers — conditional second app only after distribution is proven; teardown lane rates the category AVOID post-MyFitnessPal acquisition.

name: AI wedding-media stack
one_line: AI-generated wedding invitations, video invites and shaadi biodata in Hindi/regional templates for Indian couples, UPI one-time Rs199-999/pack, Instagram-Reels + Rs5K Meta ads to 'engaged' audiences, timed to the Nov-Feb wedding season.

name: AI micro-drama content supplier (regional)
one_line: Solo supplier of AI-scripted/AI-dubbed regional-language vertical serials to India's booming micro-drama platforms (Kuku TV/ReelSaga) or a faceless serial channel — licensing + ad revenue, <Rs10K cost, riding the $300M/17M-payer market without building a platform.

name: AI English-speaking practice, vernacular wedge
one_line: Narrow AI spoken-English trainer (e.g., nursing/pharma job-interview English with Tier-2/3 vernacular instruction) for Indian jobseekers at ~Rs99/mo, flanking SpeakX's proven Rs5cr/mo center.

name: AI-skills/automation digital products on Whop/Gumroad
one_line: Pseudonymous $19-79 templates/playbooks (Claude agent workflows, n8n packs, Notion-style products) plus a $15-30/mo community for US/UK/EU buyers, Easlo-pattern free-template flywheel on X/Reddit; fastest cash, brutal $74/mo median.

name: GLP-1 companion micro-app + printables
one_line: Photo-based protein-first tracker + shot-day scheduler + side-effect diary for US/UK GLP-1 users at $9.99/mo or $49 lifetime ('tracking, not medical advice'), paired with Etsy GLP-1 meal-plan printables for near-term cash; incumbents only entered May 2026.

name: No-bank-connection subscription auditor
one_line: Privacy-positioned subscription tracker + AI cancellation-script generator ('the tracker that can't see your bank', email-receipt parsing) for US consumers at $5/mo or $25/yr, marketed on Rocket Money complaint threads and 'Rocket Money alternative' SEO.

name: AI score/roast shareable-card generator
one_line: Umax-pattern free score/roast (resume roast, dating-profile audit, LinkedIn photo rating — never portfolios) with a shareable result card seeded via Rs50-100 India/US nano-creators, paywalled at $3.99-4.99/wk US pricing; includes 72-hour wave-surfing filter wrappers and seasonal 'Wrapped-for-X' variants as top-of-funnel.

name: Etsy/Pinterest AI digital planners & printables
one_line: AI-generated planner/spreadsheet/printable lines (budget, ADHD, wedding, GLP-1 meal plans) sold $5-40 one-off on Etsy with Pinterest as the compounding traffic channel — fastest cash in the Western-demand lane, weakest moat.
